'''Madeleine''' (Japanese: '''みやび''' ''Miyabi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP244|Enlighten Up!]]''.

She is a student of ten years at the [[Slowpoke Temple]] in [[Johto]]. She is the follower of a religion similar to {{wp|Buddhism}} in which the founder meditated along with some {{p|Slowpoke}} until he cleared his head of all worldly thoughts and found enlightenment.

She had previously meditated along with {{Gary}}, spurring on {{Ash}} to attempt the temple training as well. Madelaine took Ash, {{ashfr}} and {{TRT}} through a series of exercises including cleaning and fishing; however, Ash and Team Rocket were too distracted to successfully complete the tasks. Later, she and her newly evolved {{p|Slowbro}} defeated the Rocket trio after they tried to steal the Slowpoke Temple's golden statue.

With its new strength, Slowbro used Confusion to stop Team Rocket from getting away with the giant statue from the Slowpoke Temple, and returned it to its rightful spot.
